quote: this work aims to improve the utility of QA systems by introducing a new task that requires both detecting unanswerable questions and generating questions closely related to the initial query and grounded in the document.

We have a human annotator evaluate 200 pairs of reformulated questions produced by zero-shot prompting with GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 on BanditQA. The question pairs are randomly shuffled to ensure the annotator remains unaware of the model source of each reformulation. The annotator then selects the more relevant question from each pair, based on alignment with the original question's intent.

We ask three crowdworkers from Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) to independently verify whether the question is answerable or not. Annotation guidelines are provided to the crowdworkers for evaluating unanswerable questions and reformulated outputs.
